_README: THIS FILE IS EDITED BY HAND. The build script never writes it.
The Inmovilla feed only carries ACTIVE listings. When a property leaves the
feed the script cannot tell whether it sold, rented, or was just unticked
for a data fix — so it parks it and waits for you to say which.
Until a ref appears here, its page stays up but says only 'no longer being
advertised' and is noindexed. It is never shown as sold.
To publish one, add an entry keyed by the CRM ref:
sold      -> SOLD / VENDIDO badge, last asking price, shown in the
'Recently sold & rented' grid on the properties page
rented    -> RENTED / ARRENDADO badge, same treatment
withdrawn -> removed from the site and dropped from the archive entirely
date is YYYY-MM-DD and only orders the grid (newest first). It is not shown.
Prices displayed are always the LAST ASKING price, never the agreed price.
The nightly build prints a warning naming any ref waiting on a decision.
Delete this _README key if it ever gets in the way — nothing reads it.
